qs.stem: If A = [[1, 1], [0, 1]], the sum of all the entries of A<sup>3</sup> is
steps: A<sup>3</sup> = [[1, 3], [0, 1]], whose entries add up to 2 + 3 = 5.
qs.trap: Computing A<sup>p</sup> as entrywise powers.

qs.stem: For z<sub>1</sub> = 2 + 4i and z<sub>2</sub> = 6 + 4i, the value of |z<sub>1</sub>z<sub>2</sub>|<sup>2</sup> is
qs.trap: Adding the squared moduli instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: If dy/dx = 2y with y(0) = 4, then y(ln 4 / 2) equals
steps: At x = ln 4/2: e<sup>ln 4</sup> = 4, so y = 4 × 4 = 16.
qs.trap: Evaluating e<sup>kx</sup> as x instead of e<sup>ln m</sup> = m.

qs.stem: The distance of the point (6, -3) from the line 3x + 4y + 14 = 0 is
qs.trap: Forgetting to divide by √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>).

qs.stem: For the vectors a = 4i −1j +2k and b = 0i +1j −3k, |a × b|<sup>2</sup> equals
qs.trap: Using + (a·b)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: A committee of 4 is chosen from 7 men and 4 women. The number of committees containing at least one woman is
qs.trap: Counting a committee with two women twice (choose one woman, then anyone).

qs.stem: The maximum value of f(x) = −2x<sup>2</sup> + 8x + 12 is
steps: The maximum occurs at x = 2 and equals 20.
qs.trap: Reading the constant term 12 as the maximum.

qs.stem: If P(A) = 1/4, P(B) = 3/10 and P(A ∩ B) = 1/20, then P(A ∪ B) is
steps: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B).
qs.trap: Forgetting to subtract the overlap.

qs.stem: The number of solutions of cos 3x = 1 in the interval [0, 2π] is
steps: Write the general solution and count the values of x that fall in [0, 2π], including both end points.
qs.trap: Missing an end point of the closed interval.

qs.stem: If the sum of the first n terms of a sequence is S<sub>n</sub> = 4n<sup>2</sup> + 4n, the 9<sup>th</sup> term is
qs.trap: Taking T<sub>k</sub> = S<sub>k</sub>.

qs.stem: If the sum of the first n terms of a sequence is S<sub>n</sub> = 3n<sup>2</sup> + 2n, the 9<sup>th</sup> term is
qs.trap: Taking T<sub>k</sub> = S<sub>k</sub>.

qs.stem: The number of symmetric relations on a set with 2 elements is
steps: A symmetric relation is fixed by choosing among the 2 diagonal pairs and the 1 unordered off-diagonal pairs.
qs.trap: Ignoring the diagonal pairs.

qs.stem: The sum of the order and the degree of the differential equation (d<sup>2</sup>y/dx<sup>2</sup>)<sup>4</sup> + (dy/dx)<sup>4</sup> = x is
steps: Degree = power of that highest derivative once the equation is a polynomial in derivatives = 4.
qs.trap: Taking the largest power anywhere as the degree.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 6 terms of the geometric progression 1, 2, 4, … is
qs.trap: Using r<sup>n+1</sup> instead of r<sup>n</sup>.

qs.stem: The distance of the point (1, -1, 4) from the plane 2x + 1y + 2z + 3 = 0 is
steps: Distance = |ax<sub>1</sub> + by<sub>1</sub> + cz<sub>1</sub> + d|/√(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup>).
qs.trap: Forgetting the square-root denominator.

qs.stem: If tan A = 1/4 and tan B = 1/6, then tan(A + B) is
steps: tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B)/(1 − tan A tan B).
qs.trap: Using + in the denominator.

qs.stem: For a binomial distribution the mean is 8 and the variance is 4. The number of trials n is
steps: Mean = np and variance = npq, so q = variance/mean = 1/2 and p = 1/2.
qs.trap: Taking n = mean or n = mean + variance.

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→0</sub> sin(7x)/(9x) equals
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: The distance between the foci of the ellipse x<sup>2</sup>/100 + y<sup>2</sup>/36 = 1 is
steps: a<sup>2</sup> = 100, b<sup>2</sup> = 36 so c<sup>2</sup> = a<sup>2</sup> − b<sup>2</sup> = 64, c = 8.
qs.trap: Giving c instead of 2c.

qs.stem: The number of ways of distributing 6 identical balls into 4 different boxes (a box may stay empty) is
steps: Number of non-negative solutions of x<sub>1</sub> + … + x<sub>4</sub> = 6 is C(6 + 4 − 1, 4 − 1).
qs.trap: Using 4<sup>6</sup> (that is for different balls).

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→1</sub> (x<sup>4</sup> − 1)/(x − 1) equals
steps: The limit is the derivative of x<sup>4</sup> at x = 1.
qs.trap: Writing a<sup>m</sup> instead of a<sup>m−1</sup>.

qs.stem: The determinant of the matrix with rows [4 3 −3]   [1 −3 −2]   [−1 4 −1] is
steps: Expand along the first row: a(ei − fh) − b(di − fg) + c(dh − eg).
qs.trap: Sign slip on the middle term of the expansion.

qs.stem: The value of the integral ∫<sub>0</sub><sup>3</sup> (5x<sup>2</sup> + 6x) dx is
qs.trap: Dropping the 1/3 or 1/2 factor.

qs.stem: If α and β are the roots of x<sup>2</sup> − 8x + 7 = 0, then α<sup>2</sup> + β<sup>2</sup> is equal to
qs.trap: Using +2αβ instead of −2αβ.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 20 terms of the arithmetic progression 2, 8, 14, … is
qs.trap: Using nd instead of (n − 1)d.

qs.stem: A wave of frequency 250 Hz has wavelength 2 m. Its speed is (in m/s)
qs.trap: Dividing instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: A car moving at 20 m/s is brought to rest by a uniform retardation of 5 m/s<sup>2</sup>. The distance travelled before stopping is (in m)
qs.trap: Forgetting the factor 2 in 2as.

qs.stem: Two capacitors of 2 μF and 3 μF are connected in parallel across a 10 V battery. The total energy stored is (in μJ)
qs.trap: Forgetting the ½ in the energy formula.

qs.stem: A body weighs 360 N on the surface of the earth (radius R). Its weight at a height of 2R above the surface is (in N)
steps: g′ = g R<sup>2</sup>/(R + h)<sup>2</sup> = g/(1 + h/R)<sup>2</sup> = g/9.
qs.trap: Dividing by (R + h) instead of (R + h)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: In Young's double-slit experiment the slit separation is 0.5 mm, the screen is 2 m away and the wavelength is 500 nm. The fringe width is (in mm)
qs.trap: Unit slip between nm, mm and m.

qs.stem: A heater of resistance 60 Ω is connected to a 120 V supply for 20 s. The heat produced is (in J)
qs.trap: Using I = V/R as the power.

qs.stem: In measuring kinetic energy K = ½mv<sup>2</sup>, the mass has a 3% error and the speed a 1% error. The maximum percentage error in K is
qs.trap: Not doubling the speed error for v<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: A 4 kg block is pulled on a rough horizontal floor (μ = 0.5) by a horizontal force of 50 N through 8 m. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the gain in kinetic energy is (in J)
steps: Net work = (F − f)d = (50 − 20) × 8 = 240 J = gain in K.E.
qs.trap: Ignoring the work done against friction.

qs.stem: Two masses 9 kg and 3 kg hang from a light string over a smooth pulley (Atwood machine). Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the tension in the string is (in N)
qs.trap: Taking the tension equal to the weight of the heavier mass.

qs.stem: The dimensional formula of (force × momentum) is
qs.trap: Adding exponents when dividing.

qs.stem: A system absorbs 620 J of heat and does 580 J of work on its surroundings. The change in its internal energy is (in J)
qs.trap: Adding work done by the system to the heat absorbed.

qs.stem: An ideal transformer has 40 turns in the primary and 10 in the secondary. The primary current is 5 A. The secondary current is (in A)
steps: Ideal transformer: V<sub>p</sub>I<sub>p</sub> = V<sub>s</sub>I<sub>s</sub>, so I<sub>s</sub>/I<sub>p</sub> = N<sub>p</sub>/N<sub>s</sub>.
qs.trap: Using the voltage ratio for currents.

qs.stem: The moment of inertia of a uniform disc of mass 6 kg and radius 1 m about an axis through its centre (perpendicular to the plane for the disc and ring) is (in kg m<sup>2</sup>)
steps: I = 0.5 MR<sup>2</sup> for a uniform disc.
qs.trap: Using the wrong numerical factor for the shape.

qs.stem: Two trains of lengths 200 m and 100 m move towards each other on parallel tracks at 10 m/s and 20 m/s. They take how many seconds to cross each other completely?
qs.trap: Using the difference of speeds (that is for the same direction).

qs.stem: Two point charges of 1 μC and 3 μC are placed 3 cm apart in air (1/4πε<sub>0</sub> = 9 × 10<sup>9</sup> N m<sup>2</sup>/C<sup>2</sup>). The force between them is (in N)
qs.trap: Converting cm to m incorrectly.

qs.stem: A 1 kg mass attached to a spring of constant 900 N/m oscillates with amplitude 2 cm. Its maximum speed is (in cm/s)
qs.trap: Using ω<sup>2</sup> instead of ω.

qs.stem: Light of wavelength 496 nm falls on a metal of work function 1.5 eV (hc = 1240 eV nm). The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons is (in eV)
qs.trap: Giving the photon energy instead of the kinetic energy.

qs.stem: A spring of force constant 200 N/m is compressed by 0.1 m. The energy stored in it is (in J)
qs.trap: Forgetting the ½, or not squaring x.

qs.stem: Two masses 2 kg and 1 kg hang from a light string over a smooth pulley (Atwood machine). Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the tension in the string is (in N)
qs.trap: Taking the tension equal to the weight of the heavier mass.

qs.stem: A spring of force constant 1000 N/m is compressed by 0.1 m. The energy stored in it is (in J)
qs.trap: Forgetting the ½, or not squaring x.

qs.stem: A Carnot engine works between a source at 800 K and a sink at 400 K. Its efficiency (in %) is
qs.trap: Using T<sub>2</sub>/T<sub>1</sub> as the efficiency.

qs.stem: In measuring kinetic energy K = ½mv<sup>2</sup>, the mass has a 4% error and the speed a 3% error. The maximum percentage error in K is
qs.trap: Not doubling the speed error for v<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: Two trains of lengths 240 m and 160 m move towards each other on parallel tracks at 25 m/s and 15 m/s. They take how many seconds to cross each other completely?
qs.trap: Using the difference of speeds (that is for the same direction).

qs.stem: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 15 cm. The image is formed at a distance (in cm) of
qs.trap: Using u as a positive number in the lens formula.

qs.stem: Resistors of 12 Ω and 4 Ω in parallel are connected in series with a 5 Ω resistor across a 24 V battery of negligible resistance. The current drawn from the battery is (in A)
qs.trap: Adding all three resistances in series.

qs.stem: For a reaction ΔH = -100 kJ and ΔS = -200 J/K. The value of ΔG at 400 K is (in kJ)
qs.trap: Not converting J to kJ.

qs.stem: The number of angular nodes in a 4p orbital is
steps: Angular nodes = l, and for a p orbital l = 1.
qs.trap: Using the number of radial nodes instead.

qs.stem: The number of different dipeptides that can be formed from 3 different amino acids (each may be used more than once) is
qs.trap: Using k(k − 1), which does not allow repeats.

qs.stem: The pH of a 10<sup>−4</sup> M NaOH solution at 25°C is
qs.trap: Reporting pOH as the pH.

qs.stem: Liquids A and B form an ideal solution of 2 mol A and 3 mol B. Their vapour pressures when pure are 300 mm Hg and 500 mm Hg. The total vapour pressure of the solution is (in mm Hg)
qs.trap: Averaging the two pure vapour pressures without weighting by mole fraction.

qs.stem: Among B, Li, C, F, the element with the highest first ionisation enthalpy is
steps: First ionisation enthalpies (kJ/mol): B 801, Li 520, C 1086, F 1681.
The highest value belongs to F.
qs.trap: Forgetting the dips at Be/B and N/O.

qs.stem: Among C, O, N, Li, the element with the lowest first ionisation enthalpy is
steps: First ionisation enthalpies (kJ/mol): C 1086, O 1314, N 1402, Li 520.
The lowest value belongs to Li.
qs.trap: Forgetting the dips at Be/B and N/O.

qs.stem: From the reaction N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> → 2NH<sub>3</sub>, the mass of NH<sub>3</sub> formed from 280 g of nitrogen (completely reacted) is (in g)
steps: 1 mol of nitrogen gives 2 mol of NH<sub>3</sub>, so moles of NH<sub>3</sub> = 20.
qs.trap: Ignoring the mole ratio in the balanced equation.

qs.stem: The degree of unsaturation (double-bond equivalents) of C<sub>7</sub>H<sub>8</sub> is
steps: DBE = (2C + 2 + N − H − X)/2 (oxygen does not count).
qs.trap: Counting oxygen or forgetting that N adds 1.

qs.stem: The number of moles of H<sub>2</sub> needed to hydrogenate 1 mole of ethyne completely is
steps: Add 1 mol H<sub>2</sub> per C=C (or per ring in a saturated ring), 2 mol per C≡C, and 3 mol per benzene ring.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as taking one mole.

qs.stem: For a reaction A + B → products, doubling [A] alone raises the rate 1 times, and doubling [B] alone raises it 2 times. The overall order of the reaction is
steps: Rate ∝ [A]<sup>x</sup>[B]<sup>y</sup>: 2<sup>x</sup> = 1 gives x = 0 and 2<sup>y</sup> = 2 gives y = 1.
qs.trap: Adding the rate factors instead of the exponents.

qs.stem: The oxidation number of Fe in K<sub>3</sub>[Fe(CN)<sub>6</sub>] is
steps: Assign O = −2 (or the usual values) and balance the total charge.
qs.trap: Forgetting the overall charge on the ion.

qs.stem: The coordination number of the metal in [NiCl<sub>4</sub>]<sup>2−</sup> is
steps: Coordination number = number of donor atoms attached to the metal = 4.
qs.trap: Counting ligands where some are bidentate.

qs.stem: The number of sigma (σ) bonds in propyne (CH<sub>3</sub>C≡CH) is
steps: Every bond has one σ bond; each double bond adds one π bond and each triple bond adds two.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as one π bond.

qs.stem: Given A → B, ΔH = −49 kJ and B → C, ΔH = −67 kJ, the enthalpy change for 2A → 2C is (in kJ)
steps: Multiplying the equation by 2 multiplies ΔH: -232 kJ.
qs.trap: Not scaling ΔH by the stoichiometric factor.

qs.stem: The mass of glucose (C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>12</sub>O<sub>6</sub>) required to prepare 1000 mL of a 1 M solution is (in g)
qs.trap: Using the volume in mL without converting to litres.

qs.stem: For N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> ⇌ 2NH<sub>3</sub> the equilibrium concentrations are [N<sub>2</sub>] = 2 M, [H<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M and [NH<sub>3</sub>] = 8 M. The value of K<sub>c</sub> is
qs.trap: Writing the ratio upside-down or ignoring the stoichiometric powers.

qs.stem: The number of lone pairs of electrons on the central atom of SO<sub>2</sub> is
steps: Steric number of S = 3 (2 bond pairs + 1 lone pairs).
qs.trap: Counting the bonded atoms instead.

qs.stem: The number of structural isomers (ignoring stereoisomers) of the alkane C<sub>7</sub>H<sub>16</sub> is
steps: Enumerate carbon skeletons, then place the functional group.
qs.trap: Missing a branched skeleton or counting stereoisomers.

qs.stem: The number of moles of O<sub>2</sub> required for complete combustion of 1 mole of the hydrocarbon C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>8</sub> is
qs.trap: Using y/2 instead of y/4.

qs.stem: 50 mL of a 2 M solution is diluted until its molarity is 0.5 M. The final volume of the solution is (in mL)
qs.trap: Giving the volume of water added instead of the final volume.

qs.stem: The mass of copper (molar mass 64 g/mol, ion charge 2+) deposited by passing 289500 C of charge is (in g; F = 96500 C/mol)
qs.trap: Ignoring the charge on the ion.

qs.stem: The number of structural isomers (ignoring stereoisomers) of the alkane C<sub>4</sub>H<sub>10</sub> is
steps: Enumerate carbon skeletons, then place the functional group.
qs.trap: Missing a branched skeleton or counting stereoisomers.

qs.stem: For hydrogen-like species, the ratio of the radius of the n = 3 orbit to that of the n = 1 orbit (same species) is
qs.trap: Using r ∝ n instead of n<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The number of different monochloro structural isomers obtainable from propane by free-radical chlorination (ignore stereoisomers) is
steps: Count the sets of equivalent hydrogens: each set gives one monochloro product.
qs.trap: Counting every hydrogen as different.
